business_overview.one_sentence: Ajisen (China) operates Japanese ramen and Japanese-style fast casual restaurants mainly in Mainland China and Hong Kong, supported by noodle and related product manufacturing.

segments.business_substance: Restaurant sales in Mainland China and Hong Kong

segments.item: Manufacture and sales of noodles and related products

business_overview.revenue_model: Restaurant revenue is recognised when customers purchase goods at restaurants and payment is due immediately; noodle/product sales usually grant 90-day credit.
business_notes: The group had 596 restaurants at 31 December 2024, up from 562 at 31 December 2023.
Takeaway revenue was RMB377 million in 2024, accounting for 25.6% of restaurant turnover with takeaway services.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow is positive, but restaurant leases and store capex consume a large share of cash. 2024 post-lease cash profit was RMB79.024m; 2023 was stronger and 2022 was weak.

No exact necessary operating cash requirement is disclosed; it must be estimated.
